name: IFS morph
description: A kaleidoscopic-IFS solid tumbling in space, morphing between four fold parameterisations on a slow cycle. Unlike the library's other fractals this one is a lit surface rather than accumulated glow — real normals, specular and Fresnel — with a flowing procedural texture on its faces.

morph.description: Rate the fold parameters cycle between the four presets.

flow.description: Speed of the curl texture running over the faces.
